newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Late SAfrica bonds strong, rand off weakest levels.
newsitem.headline: Late SAfrica bonds strong, rand off weakest levels.

text.p: 1409 GMT - Late bonds near intraday firmest levels after good morning session which saw yields march lower on broad-based interest.
Rand off day's softest weakest level after gradual softening throughout the day in thin volumes.
* Debt traders say some consolidation on the horizon at current levels after recent strong run. A lot of stock still floating around.
* Small-scale volatility seen ahead of options close-out on August 7.
* Stronger U.S. Treasuries having some knock-on effect on local market.
* Rand last at 4.5910/5940 against the dollar from 4.5880/5910 at 1400 GMT on Wednesday and intraday weakest bid of 4.5940. Softer trend seen on Thursday.
